205864: Ruth Rubin and the Study of Yiddish Folksong Today: Ruth Rubin was a renowned folklorist and singer who spent decades preserving the musical tradition of Ashkenazi Jews. The program features presentations by Isabel Frey and Miriam Borden, followed by a discussion moderated by Mark Slobin, in honor of what would have been Rubin's 120th birthday.
